title: Yacht Guitar Orchestra
summary: Rubella and Lillith sunbathing on a yacht while a guitar line plays the rail. Three-song hard-cut journey in twenty silent Imagine scenes (about 3:24, working times): daylight vine island with guitar orchestra bed, dark island fire with Wallisian bed, night approach to Busan Gwangan Bridge with Korean K-pop bed. Every mouth stays closed, the vocals are off-picture. No landing.
visualArc: Open ocean lounges + guitar line → the sway, prow and wake, a chord ripple down the necks → sunglasses reflect the vine island → shore cannons, a pick over the rail, one dolphin leap, too many parrots → hard cut dark: lights in the vines, beach fire, faces and a cannon in firelight, the parrots leave, the lounges in the dark → hard cut night: Busan Gwangan Bridge RGB + Marine City, light on the hull, the ring from above, a strip of black water that never closes.

segments.label: A — Open ocean
segments.onScreen: A white yacht on open turquoise water, a guitar line on the rail, two black-lace sunbathers, and an island rising at the horizon.
segments.musicCue: Bed: Yacht Guitar Orchestra, Clean Line alone from the first downbeat (96 BPM, D major). Picture sound laid in the edit: soft hull hiss and open-water wash, very low. No gulls, no engine. The bed stays on top the whole scene.
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Start from a wide, bright midday shot filmed by a drone gliding alongside the starboard side of a sleek white luxury motor yacht at deck height, on glassy turquoise open ocean with an empty horizon. A living orchestra of women in plain ivory sleeveless deck dresses stands an arm's length apart along the entire deck rail, each holding a clean electric guitar (Stratocasters and Telecasters) at playing height, facing outward toward camera, calm faces, eyes open, lips closed. On the aft sun deck, Rubella, a glamorous, exhausted woman with long dark hair and blood-red lipstick in a modern black lace evening dress, and Lillith, a glamorous woman in black lace with flawless, never-smudged mascara and a bright, conspiratorial half-smile, lie on white lounges in dark sunglasses, not performing, faces calm. Slow approach: in the last third a small vine-covered volcanic island rises at the far horizon with one tiny white plume of steam. Gentle synchronized sway of the guitar line as if playing long sustained chords, mouths closed, no frantic strumming, no one boards or leaves the yacht, cannons rusted and still, boat does not land. Photoreal, 16:9, 35mm, fine grain, no text, 15 seconds, Grok Imagine style
